apiKeys.title: API Key Management

quotaForm.multiWindowHint: Multi-window quota: enforced HOUR -> DAY -> MONTH -> MINUTE via the quota ledger (active when trunkline.quota.enabled=true)
quotaForm.amountEstimateHint: Estimated from the prices of the allowed virtual models; the token limit is authoritative
quotaForm.amountUnavailableHint: The selected virtual models have no price configured. Set the monthly Token limit instead.
quotaForm.ledgerOffTitle: Hourly and monthly limits are not enforced right now
quotaForm.ledgerOffDesc: Only the daily request limit, daily token limit and per-minute rate limit are actually enforced. Hourly and monthly limits are stored but never return 429. They take effect once the multi-window quota ledger is enabled.
quotaForm.inertFieldHint: The multi-window quota ledger is off, so this limit is recorded but not enforced.
quotaForm.presetInertHint: Hourly and monthly limits in the presets are not enforced with the current configuration; they were applied as 0.

form.descriptionRequired: Please enter a description for this key
form.expiresAtHint: Defaults to 90 days; clear for never expires
form.permissionsHint: Defines which API categories this key may call (e.g. /v1/chat/completions is chat). Must match the category of the model groups it accesses, otherwise the call is rejected. Chat is checked by default
form.quotaPresetHint: Pick a preset to fill the limits below (0 = unlimited), still adjustable
form.ipWhitelistPlaceholder: Leave empty to allow all IPs
form.ipWhitelistHint: IP addresses allowed to use this key; empty means no restriction
form.allowedGroupsPlaceholder: Leave empty to allow all groups
form.allowedGroupsHint: Restrict this key to the selected model groups (pools). Empty means no extra group restriction.
form.permissionsMismatch: The selected model group belongs to the "{categories}" category, which is not checked under "Callable model categories". Calls will be rejected with 403. Please check the matching category.
form.tokenLimitHint: Daily token usage cap; 0 means no limit
form.rateLimitHint: Per-minute request rate cap; 0 means no limit
form.thresholdHint: Trigger an alert when quota usage reaches this ratio
form.rotationPeriodHint: Auto-rotation period for the key (in days); 0 means no auto-rotation
form.allowedGroupsScopeHint: Only model groups whose categories match the checked permissions are listed
form.gate1Desc: Gate 1 — Model whitelist (optional): restrict which virtual models the key can call; leave empty = all allowed; category permissions follow the whitelist automatically
form.gate2Desc: Gate 2 — Safety rails (optional): expiry time, IP whitelist and quotas as a backstop
form.advancedHint: Description is enough for normal use; whitelist, expiry, IP / quota limits live in advanced mode
form.subtitleCreate: Issue an AI calling key to an employee; they can only use the virtual models you tick.
form.subtitleEdit: Change the purpose, allowed virtual models and quota of this key.
form.purposeLabel: What is this key used for?
form.holderPlaceholder: Pick an employee (leave empty to keep it yourself)
form.holderHint: The picked employee is shown as the "Holder" in the list, so you can trace who the key was issued to.
form.groupsHint: Unticked virtual models are not reachable with this key.
form.groupsEmpty: No virtual model yet — create one on the "Virtual Models" page first.
form.monthlyQuotaHint: Unit: CNY, 0 = unlimited. Employees can ask for a raise when it runs out.
form.monthlyTokenHint: About {tokens} tokens (estimated from the price of the selected virtual models; the token limit is what actually applies)
form.monthlyTokenOnlyHint: Unit: tokens, 0 = unlimited. The selected virtual models have no price configured, so a CNY amount cannot be derived.
form.groupsLabel: Which virtual models can this person use?

confirmations.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete API key {keyId}? This action cannot be undone.
confirmations.deleteImpact: If applications are still calling this key, they will immediately start receiving 401 authentication failures.
confirmations.deleteRemedy: You can create a new key if this was a mistake; the old key value cannot be recovered and every consumer must be updated.
confirmations.resetMessage: Are you sure you want to reset API key {keyId}? The old key value will be invalidated immediately. The holder can view and copy the new key in My Keys.
confirmations.resetImpact: If applications are still calling this key, the old value is invalidated immediately and they will start failing with 401 until the holder re-copies the new value from My Keys.
confirmations.resetRemedy: Reset cannot be undone. Notify the key holder (employee) in advance so they can copy the new value from My Keys and update every consumer; the new value is shown only once and will not be displayed again, even to admins.
confirmations.rotateMessage: Are you sure you want to rotate API key {keyId}? The old key value will be invalidated immediately. The holder can view and copy the new key in My Keys. The lastRotatedAt timestamp will be updated.
confirmations.rotateImpact: If applications are still calling this key, the old value is invalidated immediately after rotation and they will start failing with 401 until the holder re-copies the new value from My Keys.
confirmations.rotateRemedy: Rotation cannot be undone. Notify the key holder (employee) in advance so they can copy the new value from My Keys and update every consumer; the new value is shown only once and will not be displayed again, even to admins.
confirmations.quotaResetMessage: Are you sure you want to reset the daily quota counter of API key {keyId}? This clears today's request and token usage.

messages.fetchListFailed: Failed to fetch the API key list
messages.keyIdTooLong: Key ID must not exceed 64 characters
messages.resetSuccess: Key reset successfully! The holder can view and copy the new key value in My Keys.
messages.rotateSuccess: Key rotated successfully! The holder can view and copy the new key value in My Keys.
messages.createSuccess: Created successfully! The key is stored encrypted. The holder can view and copy the key value in My Keys.
messages.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please copy it manually
messages.whitelistMismatchBlocked: Save failed: the categories of these models/groups are not covered by the key permissions — {detail}. Grant those categories or remove them from the whitelist.

batch.deleteImpact: Impact: {count} key(s) will be invalidated immediately; calls using them will return 401
batch.deleteRemedy: Remedy: deleted keys cannot be restored; you must issue new keys and update your clients

apiKeys.listHint: Click "Troubleshoot" to see how this person has been using it

troubleshoot.title: 🔍 Key troubleshooting: {description}
troubleshoot.statusOk: Key status is normal, it has not been disabled
troubleshoot.disabled: This key has been disabled, calls will be rejected
troubleshoot.expired: This key expired on {date}, calls will be rejected
troubleshoot.noQuotaLimit: No monthly budget set, amount is unlimited
troubleshoot.quotaUnknown: Quota ledger is off, this month's usage cannot be shown
troubleshoot.quotaOk: Budget is enough, used {used} / {limit} this month ({percent}%)
troubleshoot.quotaLow: Budget is almost used up, used {used} / {limit} this month ({percent}%)
troubleshoot.groupsUnlimited: No virtual model restriction, all groups of that category are reachable
troubleshoot.groupsOk: Available virtual models are fine: {names} are all online
troubleshoot.groupsOffline: Available virtual models are broken: {names} have no usable instance
troubleshoot.callsUnknown: Call history is disabled, last 24 hours cannot be counted
troubleshoot.callsOk: In the last 24 hours {success} calls succeeded, {failed} failed — nothing abnormal
troubleshoot.callsFailed: In the last 24 hours {success} calls succeeded, {failed} failed — check the failure reason
troubleshoot.commonTitle: If an employee says "it doesn't work", usual reasons:
troubleshoot.hint1: Wrong API base URL → it should be the gateway address, not the vendor address
troubleshoot.hint2: The virtual model was not ticked → go back to the create form and tick it
troubleshoot.hint3: The key expired → check whether the expiry date has passed

recycle.title: ⚠️ Recycle this key?
recycle.subtitle: {description} · {groups} · issued {days} days ago, never used
recycle.line1: After recycling, {holder} can no longer use this key and their AI calls will fail immediately.
recycle.line2: This key has a {amount} budget; after recycling it will not be charged next month.
recycle.recoverable: Recycling disables the key — an admin can re-enable it at any time.
